app.offline.title.description: Bold lead-in of the banner shown while the device has no network

app.offline.body.defaultMessage: Saved pages still open. We'll catch up when you're back online.

app.update.message.defaultMessage: A new version of TodayZ Admin is ready.
app.update.message.description: Toast shown when a new version of the app is waiting. The page never reloads until the person taps Update, and never while a sale or checkout is open.

app.update.action.description: Button in the update toast; reloads the app

app.error.title.description: Heading of the screen shown when the app crashes

app.error.body.defaultMessage: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.

app.loading.description: Spoken while the app checks whether you are signed in

auth.signIn.sub.defaultMessage: Use your staff mobile number. We'll send a code by SMS, then ask for your authenticator code.

auth.phone.label.description: Label of the phone field. The +91 prefix is shown beside it.

auth.phone.help.description: Help text under the phone field

auth.phone.invalid.defaultMessage: Enter a 10-digit mobile number that starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9.

auth.code.send.description: Button that sends the SMS code

auth.code.sending.description: Spoken while the code is being sent

auth.code.label.description: Name of the group of six code boxes

auth.code.digit.description: Name of code box number {position}, 2 to 6

auth.code.sentTo.description: Line above the code boxes. {phone} is the number with some digits hidden.

auth.code.verifying.description: Spoken while the code is being checked

auth.code.resend.description: Button to ask for a new code

auth.code.resendIn.description: Disabled button while the resend timer runs. {seconds} counts down.

auth.code.change.description: Button that goes back to the phone field

auth.error.wrongCode.defaultMessage: That code is not right. Check it and try again.

auth.error.expired.defaultMessage: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.

auth.error.locked.defaultMessage: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new code.
auth.error.locked.description: Too many wrong attempts on one code

auth.error.rateLimited.defaultMessage: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.

auth.error.blocked.defaultMessage: This account can't sign in right now. Contact support.

auth.error.network.defaultMessage: We can't reach TodayZ. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.description: No network or the server did not answer

auth.error.generic.defaultMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.error.captcha.defaultMessage: We couldn't check that you are a person. Reload the page and try again.
auth.error.captcha.description: The Turnstile check failed to load or run

auth.signOut.description: Button that ends the session on this device

auth.twoStep.verifySub.defaultMessage: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for TodayZ.
auth.twoStep.verifySub.description: A-01 line under the heading when the admin already has an authenticator

auth.twoStep.enrolSub.defaultMessage: Set up an authenticator app before you continue. You only do this once.
auth.twoStep.enrolSub.description: A-01 line under the heading on first sign-in

auth.twoStep.loading.description: Spoken while the authenticator setup loads

auth.twoStep.unavailable.defaultMessage: The two-step check is not available yet. Try again in a moment.
auth.twoStep.unavailable.description: The enrol or verify call failed or does not exist yet

auth.twoStep.retry.description: Button that loads the two-step setup again

auth.twoStep.secretLabel.description: Label of the authenticator secret shown for typing in by hand

auth.twoStep.secretHelp.defaultMessage: In your authenticator app choose "Enter a setup key", paste this key and pick time-based.

auth.twoStep.uriOpen.description: Link that opens the otpauth address

auth.twoStep.codeLabel.description: Name of the group of six code boxes for the authenticator code

auth.twoStep.confirm.description: Button that sends the authenticator code

auth.twoStep.wrong.defaultMessage: That code is not right. Check the time on your phone and try again.

auth.twoStep.wrongLeft.defaultMessage: That code is not right. {count, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
auth.twoStep.wrongLeft.description: Wrong authenticator code with the tries left. {count} is the number left.

auth.twoStep.locked.defaultMessage: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
auth.twoStep.locked.description: The admin sessions were ended after too many wrong authenticator codes

auth.twoStep.signInAgain.description: Button that returns to the phone step after a lock

auth.twoStep.useRecovery.description: Link that switches to the recovery code form

auth.twoStep.useApp.description: Link that switches back to the authenticator code

auth.recovery.label.description: Label of the recovery code field

auth.recovery.help.defaultMessage: Each code works once. Hyphens and spaces are ignored.
auth.recovery.help.description: Help under the recovery code field

auth.recovery.submit.description: Button that sends the recovery code

auth.recovery.wrong.defaultMessage: That recovery code is not right or was already used.

auth.recovery.left.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# recovery code left} other {# recovery codes left}}. Ask a super admin for a reset when you run low.
auth.recovery.left.description: Shown after a recovery code was used. {count} is how many are left.

auth.recovery.shownTitle.description: Heading of the screen that shows the 10 recovery codes once

auth.recovery.shownBody.defaultMessage: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe, away from this device.
auth.recovery.shownBody.description: Body of the recovery codes screen

auth.recovery.listLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of recovery codes

auth.recovery.saved.description: Checkbox label; the person confirms they stored the codes

auth.recovery.continue.description: Button after the recovery codes were saved

auth.recovery.continueRecover.description: Button after a recovery code was accepted
